SELECT r.id, r.role_name, r.role_code, r.display_name, r.description, r.level, r.is_system, r.status, r.created_at, r.updated_at FROM roles r INNER JOIN user_roles ur ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'ACTIVE' AND (ur.effective_from IS NULL OR ur.effective_from <= CURRENT_DATE) AND (ur.effective_to IS NULL OR ur.effective_to >= CURRENT_DATE) ORDER BY r.level DESC, r.id

SELECT
FROM roles WHERE status = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY level DESC, id
mapper.update: UPDATE roles SET role_name = #{roleName}, role_code = #{roleCode}, display_name = #{displayName}, description = #{description}, level = #{level}, is_system = #{isSystem}, status = #{status} WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select:
SELECT
FROM roles ORDER BY level DESC, id LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
